_provenance.rule: One record per Wazuh rule id that appears in the SVC_04 dataset. Rule ids, descriptions and hosts are taken from the dataset prose; the category and severity hints are a plain reading of that prose and are labelled as fixture metadata, not as Wazuh's own classification.
notes: The fixture is keyed by rule id, not by case: rule id 31103 appears in several cases with different hosts, so host lists carry every host the dataset uses for that rule.
This is context a real deployment would read from the SIEM. It is deliberately thin: it must not be able to 'decide' anything the alert text does not already contain.

31103.description: Vulnerability scan signature matched (possible port scan / scanner activity)

31151.description: Repeated 404 responses indicating directory brute force against the API

5710.description: Multiple authentication failures followed by a successful login

87105.description: Outdated SSL certificate detected on an internal portal

92032.description: Suspicious PowerShell execution with an encoded command

550.description: File integrity monitoring event: a critical file was modified outside a change window

92010.description: Unusual process execution detected from a non-standard path

escalationPolicy.ruleLevels: Wazuh rule levels run 0-15; 12 and above is severe and can never be auto-closed
escalationPolicy.allowlistMatch: exact-string match on the full IP address
escalationPolicy.corroboration: failed logins, a successful login after failures, new binaries, new scheduled tasks, outbound connections, or one source hitting multiple hosts
